title: Bounded fail-closed numeric safety
problem_solved: Prevent unsupported, unavailable, or out-of-scope evidence from becoming an accepted normative numeric conclusion.
responsibility_boundary: Own the safety obligation that evidence-sensitive numeric/normative claims must be traceable to sufficient applicable evidence, and that insufficient evidence must produce an explicit bounded outcome rather than invented certainty. It does not own domain applicability rules, source acquisition, retrieval architecture, or a universal semantic validator.
portable_obligations: every accepted normative or quantitative conclusion is linked to sufficient evidence
evidence has an inspectable source/locator identity when the domain requires it
missing or unreliable evidence does not silently become a numeric conclusion
known applicability and evidence limits remain visible
replaceability: The safety obligation may be realized by deterministic checks, structured evidence binding, Domain-specific evaluation, model behavior, human review, or a composition of mechanisms. No current implementation has permanent privilege.
reuse_preconditions: the target domain defines what counts as sufficient/applicable evidence
the benchmark includes both positive and insufficient-evidence cases
numeric/normative claims can be traced to evidence at the target responsibility boundary
target-context evaluation is run before broader safety claims are made
known_limits: this is not a universal semantic truth validator
the proven professional evidence scope is bounded to the Phase 2 Building Regulation pilot
reuse in another domain requires its own evidence sufficiency and applicability rules
this asset does not justify new Platform Core policy fields or a generic Evidence Engine
governance_note: This is governed safety knowledge, not a Platform Capability identity, Platform policy object, or universal domain rule.
